reviews.comment: Mr. Crawford was one of the kindest humans I have ever met but his exams are so difficult and nothing like the study guides. His lectures are engaging and he offers feedback on assignments, but the exams really tank your grade. I didn't fail a single exam and still ended up with a C. If you're bad at history I do not recommend taking him.
Very tough grader, and the grading criteria is very ambiguous. For tests, the questions are hard, require you to have great understanding of the context, not just remember what happened.

Hated history until his class! He teaches history like it's a funny story making it super easy to follow. He doesn't post any slides so I recommend going to class. He is always willing to help and answering any questions! His exams are straightforward, and I found that taking notes using his same verbiage was really beneficial for most questions.

If you are looking for the best professor ever, take professor Crawford. His lectures are just so easy to follow, he's funny, and is very opened to help you and pass the class. His reviews for exams are really helpful, and exams are very straightforward. If I can take him again, I definitely would say yes!

Love Mr. Crawford! I'm really bad at history, but he made it interesting. No slides or notes posted so going to lectures is necessary even though not mandatory. There are books you have to read for the class that will appear on the tests. I took him for 105 and am currently taking him for 106. He's awesome and passionate/knowledgable about history.
Made an account just to say that Noah Crawford is an amazing professor. His lectures are great and he is very kind and understanding.

You can tell that Professor Crawford is very knowledgeable and has a passion for history. He is very kind and caring and genuinely enjoys teaching. His lectures are not boring. The tests are based heavily on lectures, and he doesn't post his lectures online, nor does the course have a textbook, so attendance is mandatory if you want a good grade.

Prof. Crawford is a super nice guy. You can take his tests at home in CStat and I accidentally forgot to complete the final on time having gotten the due date mixed up. I emailed him the day of the final an hour or so after it had already been due explaining the situation. He re-opened the test just for me and I was able to finish with an A.

TAKE HIM!!! He's so sweet, and his lectures are very engaging. His tests are online and at home. The only annoying part of this class is that you have to attend lectures because he doesn't post the slides. Graded is based off of 2 exams + 1 final, a weekly source every week and 1 paper. You also have to read two books. Overall, super duper easy.

I honestly don't know how this was an easy class. I took notes and never missed lecture but the exams were so hard. They're supposedly "common sense" answers. Each exam is 50 questions, there are two required books to read and one essay. He doesn't post notes so studying for exams is hard. Hes really nice but if focusing is hard I wouldnt recommend
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Very good prof, def take him
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Crawford was great and while attendance is not mandatory he does not post slides and his tests are what was covered in lecture, so I would recommend you go. He was really easy and not a tough grader at all. His class is mostly tests but you can even it out with his mini paper and weekly assignments. Very easy course. If you have the chance take him

Professor Crawford had amazing lectures. The tests are open-note and extremely easy if you go to the lectures. The only other assignments are weekly paragraphs on some historical sources and a small essay, all of which are really simple. He's not a tough grader either, so this class extremely easy.

i would recommend writing down every single thing he says in lecture. makes tests much easier, as most of the questions come straight from the words he says in lecture, with a few questions being from the "required" reading book (i didn't read and did fine). open note tests with one paper and weekly assignments, pretty chill class!

You have to be there in lecture because he won't post his slides and mainly just talks from his notes with few words on the slides anyway. Exams are all online and have no final and none of the exams are cumulative. The only thing that could make his rating higher was if some of the material was more accessible outside of class. Take him

I love Professor Crawford. His lectures are interesting and as long as you take notes in class, you will do fine on the test. There are 10 assignments that equal a test grade and none of them are hard. We had one paper but if you send it to him early he will give you feedback! I would definitely take him for another history class.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: As long as you attend the lectures (which are very interesting), you should get an A. One of the best professors I've had. I normally don't like history, but his lectures were genuinely engaging.

Super funny and passionate during his lectures! Would absolutely recommend him. Exams don't have to be taken in person and only a simple short paragraph is due every week. He is overall such a great professor.
Very engaging prof with interesting lectures, tests, and homework are light and easy. Doesn't matter if you read the books or not
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: This class is very straightforward with one easy assignment each week and a few online exams. It is important to attend lectures since he doesn't post slides and many of the exam questions are based on his opinion. He's a very nice and funny guy and the lectures are enjoyable. Make sure not to miss any assignments!

A wonderful teacher. History is not my thing, but his lectures were very engaging and easy to follow. As long as you attend lectures and take good notes, you should do well on the test. His office hours are the biggest help, you can sit down talk to him and go over any lecture and test. Just overall an amazing guy.

Crawford's a great proffesor and his lectures are super easy to pay attention to. The only thing is he doesn't have notes on canvas so if you miss a class the only way to makeup is to get notes from a friend. but his tests (3) are super nice and you can take them at home. So basically open note
Really Nice and respectful; Show up to class since the slides are not posted. Has Extra credit towards the end of the semester. All tests are online, so take them wherever you want

Mr. Crawford is a fantastic teacher. I usually despise history classes, but his lectures were very engaging and easy to follow. As long as you attend lectures and take good notes, you should do well on the test. Please don't skip any of the weekly assignments; they really help boost your grade.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: he is so baby yall like he is so nice and awkward but he makes lectures interesting. he is young enough to throw in jokes during lectures, which you do have to attend since no slides/notes are posted, but it is not bad at all! online exams, 3 books to read but it's easy. 10/10 recommend.
Nothing but great things to say, reasonable assignments and fun lectures. Tests are online and graded immediately.

You have to attend lectures and take good notes because he does not have slideshows with notes—he just talks, you write things down, and that's what's on the tests. He genuinely has some of the most engaging lectures I've ever been in, though, even coming from someone not interested in History. Great guy.

Mr. Crawford is the best history teacher I have ever had. His lectures are very thorough, and keep you engaged and interested in what he is teaching. Tests are based on the lectures, so attending class is very important. The textbooks are all free, and there is a mini-paper based on one of the textbooks that he is more than happy to help you with.

Amazing professor. Only teacher who has ever made history interesting. He tells it like a story in order to keep engaged. There are weekly written assignments. You have to go to class to do good on the test, he lectures entirely and tests on the interpretations he says in class.

Class is made up of weekly assignments, 3 take home tests, and mini-paper. Weekly assignments are very easy. Make sure to go to class since his tests are made up of the material from lectures and the three books. Very enthusiastic man and I enjoyed his lectures. I would definitely take him again!

Kind and caring professor. One assignment a week that was short. All open note exams, easy if you take good notes. Doesn't post his lecture slides on Canvas but accommodates if you can't make it to class. Three required books tested over with not many questions and one paper. Makes lectures entertaining and enjoyable, can tell he loves what he does

Super super nice guy. Very easy to talk to about anything and genuinely cares about his students. Would find ways to make things interesting and is obviously passionate about teaching. Would 1000% recommend him!!

Noah Crawford has been one of my favorite instructors at A&M so far. Every lecture is very interesting and engaging, and teaches history from a very holistic perspective. He uncovers the motivations and deeper roots of why/how things happened and helped me realize the true importance of learning about the past. Would definitely take him again.

Professor Crawford has been the best professor of any class I have taken in college. His lectures are so interesting and entertaining, and he is really passionate about what he teaches. This class was so impactful that it inspired me to pursue a minor in history. I would totally recommend this class to anyone! Take if you can!

Take this professor. Exams are based on your in-class notes. Take good notes. There is 1 writing assignment which is over one of the 3 short books you already have to read. (exams have a few problems over those books) Gives extra credit at the end of the semester if you do the mini-paper on a movie. Take Crawford and no one else.
Everything is based off the lectures but his exams are super easy if you go to class and take competent notes. Also...they're open notes.

Mr. Crawford, is so chill and funny he is a great teacher! Attendance isn't taken but it's all strictly lecture and nothing is posted, if you do have to miss he is accommodating though. There is very little homework, only a quick assignment each week and a project based off one of three books you read. Tests are open note and not really difficult.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Mr. Crawford is an amazing professor! He is very funny and laid back. Attendance is not taken in class but you need to attend because nothing is posted. His lectures are very interesting and well-planned. You are required to read 3 books and write a paper on one during the semester. You have weekly sources but no other homework. Exams are open-note

He really is passionate about his topic and how well his students learn the material. If you do not attend class, you will not be prepared for what is on the exam. He does provide exam clues but you have to be in class to utilize them. His homework is easy points.

Professor Crawford is amazing! His lectures are clear and engaging and he pauses often to see if anyone has questions. He genuinely cares about the material he is teaching and wants his students to succeed. The homework is very easy and the tests are reasonable. Attendance is vital because he covers a lot of material and doesn't post his lectures.

Mr. Crawford is an amazing professor. He is such a great lecturer and every class was interesting. He is super caring and also really funny. There are 3 exams which are easy, weekly journal assignments, and an essay. I would highly recommend taking him if you get the opportunity. He's the best.

AMAZING Professor. I'm so glad that my professor was switched to him before the semester started. He doesn't post the lecture notes so you have to attend class. However, he makes his lectures very entertaining, and he is very funny. 3 exams, 1 paper, and there's a weekly assignment that is super easy. Overall, TAKE HIM IF YOU CAN.

I was so lucky that my professor changed last minute to Professor Crawford. Amazing guy, super intelligent, hilarious. Each class is entertaining and he knows how to keep you engaged. There's one large paper, 3 exams, and weekly assignments that's super easy. keep in mind he doesn't post lecture notes, so you have to show up. Take him if you can!!

Professor Crawford Crawford did an amazing job at keeping the lecture easy to understand and interesting. He is more engaging than any professor I've had, basically after every topic in lecture he makes sure all questions are answered and understood. Work load is not heavy, definitely recommend taking this course with Professor Crawford.

Professor Crawford does an excellent job of explaining detail and conveying a clear main idea. What I enjoy is that not only is he is well-organized, enthusiastic and relatable, but he also provides adequate leverage, such as additional feedback and occasional deadline extensions. With very little to improve on, his class is much ideal for history.
